definition.name: Actual Go default baseline and managed live stack GC and heap costs

steps.name: Reject fabricated memory observations and changed original products
Authenticate the completed exact producer before restoring any executable
Restore only the authenticated public normal Go products
Install the existing network-denied compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the exact maintained Go compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "7226736c2339719cda28fbf3a54d71aa63bcefe376e98cef00034268dab24840  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go-async"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-runtime-costs-tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile identical ordinary source and execute both real signed profiles
Retain bounded source builds real memory results and physical retirement including failures

with.name: go-runtime-costs-reference-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs-producer.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/stack-placement/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/stack-placement/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/go-runtime-costs/profile-*/controls/*.json

reviewReason: Replace the expired fixed Go producer command with selected run, job and digest authentication, exact current source and the same signed cost programme; retain all other jobs and steps.
